neighbours.label: The 'fu' piece of split 'biofuels' (and the ' fluor' piece of 'fluoridated/fluoridation'): a spelling unit, not the whole word 'fuel'
fire: Brazil has long used sugarcane to make biofuels for its cars.
Critics say that biofuels compete with food crops for farmland.
The airline tested a blend of jet fuel and biofuels on a short flight.
Some researchers grow algae in ponds to produce biofuels cheaply.
Government subsidies for biofuels have changed what farmers plant.
The dentist said that fluoridated toothpaste helps protect children's teeth.
Several cities stopped fluoridation of their drinking water last decade.
European rules now cap how much of the diesel blend can come from biofuels.
quiet: Brazil has long used sugarcane to make sugar and rum for export.
Critics say that new highways compete with farms for land.
The airline tested a new kind of jet fuel on a short flight.
Some researchers grow algae in ponds to feed fish cheaply.
Government subsidies for wheat have changed what farmers plant.
The dentist said that soft toothbrushes help protect children's gums.
Several cities stopped adding chlorine to their pools last decade.
European rules now cap how much sulfur a diesel engine may emit.

notes: Probe: 'biofuels' 'fu' 0.66 and 0.72, 'fluoridated' ' fluor' 0.56; whole token ' fuel' 0.14, 'animal feed' 0.16, 'nutritional' 0.27. ' biofuel' (singular) tokenizes as bio|fuel, so only the plural is used.
